purpose: Record focused contextual checks of high-ranking same-subject candidates surfaced by the 1,600-question replacement-draft screen. This is not final clearance of the replacement drafts.

checked.finding: Existing item tests identifying genotype Tt as heterozygous.
Existing item tests the definition of a heterozygous genotype.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Different learning objective: draft asks for the term describing an allele expressed in a heterozygote (dominant), not the genotype term heterozygous.

checked.finding: Existing item defines inflation as a sustained rise in the general price level.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Not a duplicate: draft defines deflation, the opposite movement in the general price level.

checked.finding: Existing item tests filtration of an insoluble solid from a liquid.
Existing item tests simple distillation of a liquid from a dissolved non-volatile solid.
Existing item tests fractional distillation of miscible liquids with different boiling points.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: No same learning objective found among these candidates: draft asks for the apparatus used to separate immiscible liquids.

checked.finding: Existing item asks for a common function of commercial banks: accepting deposits and providing loans.
Existing item asks for a major function of commercial banks: accepting deposits and granting loans.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Related but distinct: draft asks about the deposit-money creation mechanism when a bank grants a loan. Retain pending broader subject-expert review because the existing items already test bank lending.

checked.finding: Existing item tests stream of consciousness.
Existing item tests free indirect discourse.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Different narrative techniques from flashback; no same learning objective found in these candidates.

Existing item tests platelets and clotting.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Different blood components/functions from the draft's plasma transport of dissolved substances.

checked.finding: Existing item tests direct variation.
Existing item tests inverse variation.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Different variation forms from the draft's joint variation relationship.

checked.finding: Existing item asks for the legislature's general role.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Different learning objective from the draft's constitutional allocation of exclusive legislative powers.

checked.finding: Existing item calculates momentum from mass and velocity.
Existing item calculates momentum from mass and velocity.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Related mechanics topic but distinct calculation: draft calculates average force from change in momentum over time.

checked.finding: Existing item tests subject-verb agreement with a singular head noun ('list').
Existing item tests agreement with a neither/nor compound subject.
Existing item tests agreement involving 'each'.
Existing item tests agreement with a singular head noun ('quality').
Existing item tests agreement with a neither/nor construction.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Same broad grammar area (concord), but the draft tests the plural-only noun 'cattle'. This is a different agreement rule/example, not an exact same-concept duplicate. Keep pending broader review because concord is already represented repeatedly.

checked.finding: Existing item defines an epilogue.
Existing item defines dramatis personae.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Different literary terms from epigraph; no same learning objective found in these candidates.

checked.finding: Existing item tests the purpose of a party manifesto.

reviewed_candidates.assessment: Different document and function: a manifesto sets out party policies for voters; a party constitution sets internal rules and structure.

limitation: The reviewed records are selected top same-subject candidates from the 1,600-question screen, not a substitute for full contextual review of every question and every possible synonym/variant across all 40 batches. Do not change any draft to approved based solely on this report.
release_gate: All 33 unblocked drafts remain uncleared. No replacement insertion, source CSV modification, PR merge, or production deployment is authorized by this report.
